title: Petra and the Cover
author: Sable Dravenmoor
blurb: Felix Coldharbour, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
